scope: Deployed observation assessment on 240 independent synthetic cases including simultaneous faults; executed-action checks are model-consistency tests.

protocol.training: First 70 healthy rows; fit eligibility checked before use. Otherwise defaults remain labelled assumptions. CUSUM bias/noise use only the first 60 assumed-healthy samples.
protocol.targets: Reported hot-spot temperature; later measured synthetic values. No hidden temperatures passed to the assessor.
protocol.inputs: Observed voltage, loading, oil, reported hot-spot and ambient only. No scenario, cooling, fault label, future row or true plant parameter.
protocol.limits: One plant family; synthetic, overlapping forecast origins. No field validation, confidence coverage or failure probability. Detection in a combined case requires every expected signal concurrently. v1 seeds 2101–2112 are historical regression only. v2 development uses 3101–3112; evaluation uses 88001–88024 after freezing the algorithm. Threshold-only comparison uses identical validity gates and forecasts with CUSUM disabled.
